messages:
Evan: FYI clicking the runtime ja guide TOC -> 'バッチ処理(continuous-batching)' yields a 404 on staging. fragment points to #continuous-batching but the heading uses the English id.
Katy: thanks, is this happening only for the ja localized page?
Evan: yeah, looks like the localization step stripped the manual anchor during export. seen in /ja/runtime/batching.html
i18n-bot: i18n-scan: detected missing fragment '#continuous-batching' in /ja/runtime/batching (staging). created ticket I18N-73.
Hiro: I touched the ja build script last sprint; probable regression in the header slugify step. I'll take a look.
Maya: if it's an automated slug mismatch we should add a small alias during i18n export to preserve English anchors. Evan, can you open a tiny PR to add the alias in the source en doc?
Evan: opened PR https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/8105 — it adds <!-- anchor: continuous-batching --> above the localized heading and a note in docs-build.md explaining why. local commands:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/i18n-anchor-preserve
echo "<!-- anchor: continuous-batching -->" > tmp && cat content/runtime/batching.md >> tmp && mv tmp content/runtime/batching.md
git commit -am "docs(i18n): preserve continuous-batching anchor for localized builds"
git push origin fix/i18n-anchor-preserve
```
Katy: nice. add a one-line changelog frontmatter so Docs release shows the fix. I'll review.
Hiro: also adding a quick unit test in the i18n pipeline to assert exported ja page contains the fragment. pushing a follow-up to the build repo.
Maya: pinged @Katy for review. small ask: tag i18n team in the PR description so we can track cross-repo changes.
Katy: approved, tiny nit: squash the whitespace commit. LGTM after that.
Evan: squashed and updated PR description. bumped for merge.
i18n-bot: PR 8105 merged to main by Katy. staging re-build scheduled.
Evan: confirmed on staging: /ja/runtime/batching now resolves #continuous-batching. closing I18N-73. thanks all! :globe_with_meridians:
